items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And I made a joke about that because Howard Patterson is always just in that feud and being one, he's just a collector of town jokes.

ctx.x: No, I don't think so. Conrad is, I think it was German, although it is spelled with a C. The Rodman is an old family name from back in the Civil War days when one of my relatives married an old Yankee Captain Rodman, and the Jones is Welsh.
And I made a joke about that because Howard Patterson is always just in that feud and being one, he's just a collector of town jokes. Let me check it. Okay, how do you spell Germanalan?
